# Section 1: Overview

# Overview
Upon reviewing the Buyer Blocking functionality, we identified a few display-related enhancements required across the screens listed below to improve visibility, tracking, and overall user experience

# 2. Requirements
• In the Buyer Blocking List View, the BSR should be displayed along with the Article Code. Additionally, an "End Customer" column is required in the grid.
• In the Buyer Blocking Detail View, the BSR should be displayed along with the Article Code. Additionally, the End Customer information should be visible on this screen.
• In the Indent List View, the BSR should be displayed along with the Article Code
